full_prompt_en: A square close anime image fills almost the entire frame with the face of a young adult man. He faces straight forward and looks directly at the viewer. Olive-green and charcoal hair falls in long uneven strands across the forehead, with a few locks curving beside the cheeks. Heavy dark eyebrows angle inward, bringing the gray-green eyes into a severe, concentrated expression. The eyes are relatively small compared with more playful anime character designs, and their highlights are restrained. His nose is described by a strong triangular side shadow and a small dark mark below, while the mouth is a firm narrow line. Angular warm-brown shadows beneath the eyes and along the cheekbones give the face weight and maturity. A dark green hood or high collar wraps the neck and shoulders, with a red inner garment visible at the throat and ochre outer fabric at the corners. The top of the head, chin, and shoulders are all cropped closely, leaving almost no background. A dark gray-green field behind the hair supplies only enough separation to read its jagged edges. Color areas are broad and flat but carefully shaped: pale ochre skin, olive hair, charcoal contours, russet neck, and mustard cloth. Thin ink lines refine eyelids, stray hairs, and a few facial creases. The gaze is the center of the image; the downward slant of brows and close crop create pressure without any visible action. Light falls from above and slightly left, opening one cheek and placing the other under a larger shadow plane. No other figure, prop, location, or readable text appears. The finish is graphic and controlled, combining mature anime proportions with a compact cinematic crop.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形近景动漫图像几乎被一位年轻成年男子的脸填满。他正面朝向并直望观者。橄榄绿与炭灰头发以长短不齐发束垂过额头，几缕弯至脸颊旁。厚重深眉向内压低，让灰绿眼睛显出严厉而集中的神情。眼睛相对于更活泼的动漫角色设计较小，高光也克制。鼻子由强烈三角侧影和下方小暗痕构成，嘴是紧抿的窄线。眼下与颧骨旁棱角分明的暖褐阴影让脸有重量与成熟感。深绿色兜帽或高领包住颈肩，喉部露出红色内衣，画角则有赭黄外层织物。头顶、下巴与肩都被紧紧裁掉，几乎没有背景。发后深灰绿色域只提供足够分离，使锯齿发缘可读。色区宽阔平坦却形状细究：浅赭皮肤、橄榄发、炭灰轮廓、赭红颈部与芥黄布料。细墨线修饰眼睑、散发和少数面部折痕。凝视是图像中心；下压眉线与近距离裁切无需可见动作便产生压迫感。光从上方略偏左落下，打开一侧脸颊，把另一侧放入更大阴影平面。没有其他人物、道具、地点或可读文字。完成度图形化而受控，结合较成熟动漫比例与紧凑电影式取景。
style_prompt_en: The mature anime treatment uses close cropping, measured facial proportions, and broad angular shadow planes. Olive, charcoal, ochre, muted red, and warm skinlike tones are organized into solid shapes with only a few small highlights. Strong inward diagonals around the focal gaze create tension; fine hair strands and crease lines add selective detail without breaking the graphic clarity. The background is reduced to a dark neutral strip, so form is built by contour and value rather than environmental context. Light from above creates a sharp cheek-and-nose geometry and a weighty shaded lower area. The finish is clean but not glossy, with restrained texture and a serious cinematic mood. Every visible shape directs attention toward the central expression.
style_prompt_zh: 成熟动漫处理采用近距离裁切、有节制的面部比例和宽阔棱角阴影平面。橄榄、炭灰、赭黄、低饱和红与暖肤色被组织成整块形状，仅有少数细小高光。焦点凝视周围的强烈向内斜线带来紧张感；细发丝与折痕线选择性增加信息，却不破坏图形清晰度。背景缩成深中性色条带，形体依靠轮廓与明度而非环境上下文建成。上方光形成清利脸颊与鼻部几何，下方阴影有重量。完成度干净却不光滑发亮，肌理克制，氛围严肃而具电影感。每处可见形状都把注意力引向中央表情。
theme_en: An intense green-haired anime face fills the frame with a fixed serious stare
theme_zh: 绿灰发动漫面孔紧贴画框，以严肃眼神直视前方
name: Seinen anime style
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
